meta.parties: Mohammadu Lebbe Et Al. v. Koreen Et Al

rules.statement: A District Court has no jurisdiction to interfere in the concerns of religious communities unless, in the rules which any religious community has made for its members in relation to the religious object which it has combined to maintain and support, a civil element enters, which brings the matter within the sphere of the civil jurisdiction of the courts.
